# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of call recordings is overwhelmingly **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, vehicle/driver tracking, location directions to drivers, gift/box handovers, payment-chasing with existing dealers, and factory-floor "production kodunga" calls. Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations**: outbound telecalling to prospects (cold calls announcing "Crayon Roofing and Structures-ல் இருந்து call பண்ணிருக்கேன்... roofing sheets JSW Steel Sir?"), inbound rate/quotation enquiries from dealers and site contractors, one recurring B2B negotiation with a fabricator over width/costing logic, and a couple of project-scale (4,000 sq.m) institutional enquiries. Given the volume of non-sales noise, this KB is built strictly from the sales-relevant segments and should be treated as a **lean, honest extraction** — not a full picture of the sales org's playbook. Where only one or two real instances of a pattern exist, that is noted.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures is a **JSW Steel direct distributor / fabricator** based at Andarkuppam check post, Manali New Town, Chennai ("இது crayon roofing company, direct distribution... JSW company இது"). Core product lines actually discussed in sales calls:

- **Metal roofing sheets (profiled, color-coated GI/GL sheets)** — the primary product. Brands mentioned: **JSW Color On Plus**, **JSW Pragathi**, **JSW Silveron Plus**, and **Asian Indradhanush** (a lower-cost alternative brand sold alongside JSW). Thickness options repeatedly quoted: **0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm**, occasionally heavier 1mm/1.2mm sheet for special jobs.
- **Colors**: sky blue, dark blue, off white, half white (aluminum white — "half white தான் Sir available," true "half white" variant not stocked), grey, brick red, "Caliphate Green" (CFG), Qualified Green/Coloron Plus Green with printed JSW branding and batch numbers for large project orders.
- **PUFF insulated panels** — "50 mm puff roof panel" quoted at ₹1600+GST per sq.m, with top/bottom thickness options.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — sold as profile-matched roll sheets, run through the same machine profile as the metal sheets ("Polycarbonate நம்மகிட்ட roll-ஆ இருக்கும், profile-ஆ ஓட்டி கொடுப்பாங்க").
- **Accessories**: purlins (parlin), L-flash, ridge/cap pieces, ventilators (Air vent), M-stand, Think Cam.
- **Fasteners & welding**: Tata-brand self-drilling/hex screws (various sizes — 1 inch, 19mm, 65mm half-thread/FD/DT), cladding screws (35mm), welding rods/electrodes (2.5mm, 3.15mm, 10kg/12kg packets).
- **Steel pipes** — one GI pipe enquiry (40x40, 60x40, 2mm hard-dip) was routed to "Bharath Sir" as it's handled separately, not confirmed as core stock.
- Company also fields enquiries it does **not** stock (nails, bolt & nut, Bhushan/Jindal brand sheet, "radiance" brand) and redirects or declines politely.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- JSW Color On Plus, 0.50mm: **₹475 + GST per sq.meter** (one call); also quoted **₹445 + GST** in another cold call for the same spec.
- JSW roofing sheet (general), 0.47mm: **₹119 + GST per kg**; 0.50mm: **₹117 + GST per kg**.
- JSW Pragathi 0.47mm: **₹405 + GST per sq.meter**.
- Asian Indradhanush 0.45mm: **₹370 + GST per sq.meter** (one call notes this moved up from ₹360 "இந்த மாசத்துல இருந்து 370 தான் இருக்கு").
- Color On Plus 0.5mm: quoted both as **₹116 + tax per kg** and **₹118-119+GST per kg** across calls — rate fluctuates by month/coil.
- AC/0.45mm alternate make: **₹370 + GST per sq.meter**, delivery in "3-4 days" if stock needs to be brought in.
- 1mm thickness special sheet: **₹880 + GST per sq.meter**; 1.2mm thickness: **₹1030/₹1565 range + GST**.
- Example full costing: 10 sheets, 10ft, 0.47mm = **₹14,653 (ex-GST) → ₹17,339 all-in (GST + loading)**.
- PUFF roof panel 50mm: **₹1600 + GST per sq.meter**, loading extra.
- Screws: hex/self-drilling **₹2.93–3.57 + GST per piece**; 19mm stitch screw **₹2.11 + tax**; 65mm half-thread **₹5.68 + tax**; boxes typically 500 pcs each.
- Welding rods: 10kg packet **₹336**, 12kg packet **₹332** (including tax); minimum order 5 cartons (12 packets/carton); **10% price hike confirmed effective 1st of the month** across welding rod, screws.
- **GST is always extra** and explicitly called out in nearly every quote ("+ GST", "18% GST").
- **Loading/transport**: company loads customer's vehicle free; if company arranges the vehicle, freight is added to the bill. For small retail/sample orders, parcel/courier service cost is borne by the customer.
- **Credit terms**: informal dealer credit of **15–40+ days** is common and chased proactively; large project orders (4,000 sq.m) get **up to 50% advance structure**, remaining tied to delivery milestones — "project orders-க்கு 100% advance pannuradhu ஆகாது... 50% time வாங்கி கொடுக்கணும்."
- **Vehicle/loading cut-off**: loading stops around **6 PM**; late-arriving vehicles are told to come "நாளைக்கு காலை 10 மணிக்கு."

## Objection Playbook

- **"Price adhigama irukku" (price too high vs. competitor)** — Rep response: acknowledge, then explain **measurement/costing logic** rather than discount blindly. In the width-dispute call, the rep patiently walked the customer through why "width-based" costing by a competitor actually yields *more* sheets needed per job (hence looks cheaper per sheet but isn't cheaper overall): "நான் 9 sheet-உ போட்டா போதும்... அவங்க இதுல நான் 9 sheet போட்டா 32 அடி cover ஆகும்... இதுதான் வித்யாசம்."
- **Small discount requests ("₹5 kammiya pannunga")** — Reps sometimes escalate internally ("Sir-கிட்ட கேட்டு பாக்குறேன்") rather than agreeing on the spot; final word always routed through "Sir"/MD.
- **Color/brand not available** — Default move: offer the closest in-stock alternative immediately rather than lose the call. E.g., customer asks for color 9001/cream → rep offers "half white" as the nearest match; customer asks for "half white" exact shade → told only "aluminum white" is stocked.
- **Delivery delay push-back** — When customers complain "ரொம்ப நாளா இருக்கு" (pending too long), reps commit to specific same-day
